title: The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not restrict access to one of its REST API routes,…
description: The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions through 1.0.16 have a vulnerability where one of its REST API routes is not access-restricted. This allows unauthenticated users to retrieve detailed reports about the server, PHP, WordPress configuration, installed plugin versions, and the site administrator's email address.
